verdict.rationale: Asaas documents its own outbound Webhooks: they are listed as an API feature, and the Sandbox lets you trigger a payment and receive the matching Webhook event. That is the base of the story, but nothing in the pack covers the reliability features the story asks for. missing for 10: signed deliveries/signature verification, automatic retries, event delivery logs, replay/redelivery of events, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can rely on signed webhook deliveries with automatic retries, event logs, and replay to keep my system consistent with payment state

citations.quote: Features such as subscriptions, payment links, split, receivables anticipation, subaccounts, invoices, and Webhooks are also available.
Simulate the payment in the Sandbox. Receive the corresponding Webhook event.
You can test flows such as creating customers, charges, payments, transfers, and Webhooks before using Production credentials.
